purpose: Track all C2 source-maintenance domains and distinguish priority reviewed-artifact coverage from long-tail domains that still need Claim-Evidence rows, source extraction, fresh review and reviewed card artifacts.

currentLimitations: Long-tail rows are coverage obligations, not completed Source Cards.
Uncovered rows cannot be used for calibrated prediction, intervention ranking, individual advice or clinical validity claims.
Triage buckets are routing labels derived from domain names and must not replace source review.
Model admission remains blocked until downstream quantitative model gates pass.
